name: The Fox in Sleepy Creek
source:
Vicki is sentenced to a winter's worth of community service for a town of sleepy bears. This city fox must learn how to exist in small town life while paying off her debt to society.

[From [url=https://plantbeargames.itch.io/the-fox-in-sleepy-creek]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维琪被判在一个困熊小镇接受为期一个冬天的社区服务。这只城市狐狸必须学会如何在小镇生活中生存，同时还清对社会的债务。

[来自[url=https://plantbeargames.itch.io/the-fox-in-sleepy-creek]Itch.io[/url]]
